digest.component_or_area: Jira coordinator — create and binding lifecycle
propositions: Failed pre-create pending save must produce zero Jira provider calls and return item-scoped persistence failure.
After Jira returns a key, the canonical rebar-id label must be attached first, entity property attempted second as optional enrichment, then persisted through RP-02 without deletion on failure.
Create timeout or connection loss must never trigger blind-replay; observation through identity/query or deferred pending record prevents duplicate issue creation across restart.
Cloud/DC crash-restart sequences must converge to exactly one remote Jira issue with one confirmed forward/reverse binding.
Keyed recovery must perform zero search; keyless recovery requires three misses plus 3600 seconds conjunction; per-ticket recovery failure must not block unrelated tickets.
